prompt:
Bug: adding a scaled recipe to a shopping list undercounts a food the recipe lists twice.

When a recipe lists the same food on two lines, adding it to a shopping list (POST /api/households/shopping/lists/{item_id}/recipe) merges the two lines into one list item. With a scale (recipe_increment_quantity) other than 1, only the first line is scaled. A recipe with quantity 1 of a food (note "batter") and quantity 2 of the same food (note "topping"), added at scale 2, gives a list item with quantity 4 instead of 6.

Expected: every line is scaled before the lines are combined. In that example the list has a single item with quantity 6 and one recipe reference with recipeQuantity 3 (the recipe's own, unscaled total) and recipeScale 2. The merging of notes and everything else about adding recipes to lists stay as they are.

Tests: `python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/integration_tests/user_household_tests/test_group_shopping_lists.py` for quick loops; the whole backend suite is `python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests` (about 8 minutes).
title: fix: scale merged duplicate ingredients when adding a recipe to a shopping list (#8764)
